evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure telemetry remains null, preventing verification of the required growth-stage pressure.
Exhaust oxygen was 1.7 ppm at the start of growth.
Exhaust oxygen has risen persistently to 25.3 ppm during growth, raising concern about atmosphere integrity without identifying a cause.
Temperature is 749.5 °C against 750 °C, argon flow is 100.3 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these readings alone do not verify the atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated tube-pressure measurement and growth-stage pressure/O2 acceptance limits are needed to verify the atmosphere; an independent O2 check and leak/exhaust-path checks would help resolve the rising oxygen signal. Sample characterization is not yet available.
